titel: Heavy runs: tests and builds through the queue
kurz: Several projects share one PC. If test suites, builds or image runs start at the same time, memory runs out and all of them fail. The AMW therefore puts such runs into one queue for the whole computer – automatically, without an agent having to remember it.
brauchst: Agent folders set up by the AMW (`amw einrichten agenten-ordner <folder>`).
The switch “Send heavy commands through the queue” under Settings › This PC (on by default).

schritte.text: Run `amw einrichten agenten-ordner <folder>` once for every agent folder. This adds the hook; running sessions pick it up after a few seconds.

If an agent starts a heavy command directly (for example the whole test suite), the command is not executed. Instead the agent gets the ready-made replacement: `amw lauf ausfuehren --beschreibung "Test-Suite" -- <its command>`. It waits until the computer is free, then runs and returns the result.
Under Settings › Project › “More heavy commands”, enter one `Name = pattern` per line, for example `Render maps = maps\.py`.

If you know what a run needs, say so: `--braucht-gb 4` (memory), optionally `--braucht-vram-gb` (graphics memory) and `--braucht-platte-gb` (free disk space). Without it the AMW uses the project's memory limit.
Home › control panel › “Computer” shows how many runs are in progress and waiting, and when the computer is expected to be free.

Its folder does not have the hook yet: run `amw einrichten agenten-ordner <folder>`.
A run waits for a long time

The control panel says why: the computer is busy, too little memory is free or a run ahead is waiting – then it also says how much memory that run needs and how much is usable. The human can move a run to the front (`amw lauf vorziehen <nr>`).
A single short test is rejected
The pattern is too broad. Single test modules stay free; make your own patterns narrower.
The pattern is not a valid regular expression, for example a bracket is missing.
The computer is idle, but nothing starts

A program outside the queue is using the memory, for example a local AI server or a virtual machine. The control panel shows under “Computer” which program it is, how much it uses and since when. Close it yourself when you no longer need it – the AMW never closes anything.
danach: Heavy by default: whole test suites, browser tests, builds and the split of the web branch.
About runs of another project you only see that the computer is busy and until when – never what is running there.
Every computer has its own queue.
fragen: How does a project get priority?

Under Settings › This PC › “Project priority” you set high, normal or low for each project. Waiting runs then go in this order: first what you moved up yourself, then “high”, then “normal”, then “low” – in order of arrival within a level. A run that is already running is never stopped. The waiting reason names the priority; in the timeline “Computer – today” priority runs are marked with ▲, and the control panel lists them briefly. The setting belongs to the PC, not to a project – you only see the names of other projects on the PC.
Why is memory set aside for a running run?

A run often needs its memory bit by bit. So that no second run starts next to it and takes that memory away, the queue keeps its need free. If it did not state a need, the limit of its project applies – but only for the first 15 minutes; after that, what it really uses counts. The waiting reason says how much is set aside for which run.
What happens if the hook fails for once?

Then the command simply runs – an error never blocks anything. The error is written to the log `%LOCALAPPDATA%\amw\hook-fehler.log` on this PC; if there is something in it, have a look, because heavy commands then start directly again.

A program that does not run through the queue and has been using a lot of memory for more than 10 minutes. The AMW only reads the name, memory and start time of the processes – no command lines. Many small processes, such as a browser, do not count.
What does the AMW do when the disk fills up?

It warns: in the control panel under “Computer” and with a message to the lead and you as soon as a drive holding the database or a project folder has less than 15 % free, and urgently below 5 %. Settings › This PC lists the drives and the clean-up suggestions: old backups with size and age. Nothing is deleted automatically. If an archive folder is set, you move old backups there with one click; every move is listed in archiv-protokoll.txt.
Can I switch this off for one computer?
Yes: Settings › This PC › switch off “Send heavy commands through the queue”. The queue itself stays, only the rejecting stops.
